messages:
sara_support: Customer reported Cost Insights dashboard shows "$0" / NaN for a small subset of orgs after last night's ingest. Org IDs: 6789, 1122, 4477. Usage numbers present but cost column is zeroed. Screenshots + CSV export attached.
eli_ops: investigating. any pattern — reserved capacity, region, or model family?
jamal_billing: quick DB peek: ledger rows exist for those orgs but the joined price column is NULL for some rows, resulting in NULL cost. looks like a price_catalog mismatch for newer model variants. running a query now.
frank_console: frontend is rendering NaN for the sparkline when totals are NULL. We have a defensive coalesce missing in one of the visualization layers. can push small patch to treat null -> 0 for display.
sara_support: repro steps I got from the customer: 1) open org page 2) set timeframe to last 7d 3) token cost tile shows "$0" 4) export CSV -> cost column blank. They reported this started after the 02:00 ingest window.
eli_ops: share the exact SQL you ran, jamal?
jamal_billing: pasted query: `-- find ledger rows with missing price key
SELECT bl.org_id, count(*) AS missing_price_rows, sum(bl.usage) AS tokens FROM billing_ledger bl LEFT JOIN price_catalog pc ON bl.price_key = pc.key WHERE pc.key IS NULL AND bl.date >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY bl.org_id;`
jamal_billing: dry-run output: org 6789 -> 14 rows missing_price, tokens 1,234,567; org 1122 -> 3 rows, tokens 45,200; org 4477 -> 1 row, tokens 12,400. So not huge, but enough to zero the totals in dashboard because SUM(cost) returns NULL when some joined rows are NULL in the current pipeline.
frank_console: I'll open a quick PR to coalesce at the visualization layer: `total_cost = coalesce(sum(cost), 0)` — this is a low-risk hotfix for display while we fix the source. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/6523 (wip).
eli_ops: plan: 1) push frontend display coalesce as immediate mitigation (deploy canary) 2) backfill missing price keys / compute cost for affected ledger rows (db job) 3) harden ingest to assert price_key exists or fallback price applied.
jamal_billing: prepping backfill SQL: `UPDATE billing_ledger bl SET cost = bl.usage * pc.fallback_price FROM price_catalog pc WHERE bl.price_key = pc.key AND bl.cost IS NULL;` — but need to verify pc.fallback_price exists for those keys; else use global default_price. I'll run a dry-run SELECT to estimate delta and open a migration job.
repro-bot: automated repro run attached: https://ci.internal/jobs/replications/38472 — reproduces NaN in the same org pages (screenshot attached to job).
eli_ops: tagging @oncall for window — recommend low-traffic window, backfill scheduled tonight 02:30, hotfix deploy to canary now.
sara_support: I messaged customer: "We're rolling a temporary display fix now and will run a full backfill tonight. We'll follow up with a confirmation when done. Sorry for the noise." :thumbsup:
frank_console: deployed canary patch to staging, smoke looks good (graphs show 0 instead of NaN). Going to prod canary rollout in 10m.
jamal_billing: ran dry-run counts + flagged ledger rows for backfill job. I'll monitor for any rounding diffs.
eli_ops: after backfill, we should re-run the materialized views and invalidate the dashboard cache for affected orgs: cache keys: cost_panel:org:6789 etc. I'll add cache invalidation step to the job.
sara_support: thanks team — I'll keep the ticket updated and mark customer as P1 until this is fully resolved.
frank_console: quick note: also add a unit test for the visualization layer to assert no NaN shown when some backend rows have NULL cost.
jamal_billing: opening INC ticket INC-2026-847 and will add runbook steps.
eli_ops: final: hotfix deployed to prod canary; scheduling backfill for 02:30; post-backfill we'll post final note to customer and close. :bell:
